mentions.name: Markdown-based website builder
mentions.description: A website builder that lets users create an entire site in markdown instead of drag and drop, offering around a dozen selectable themes. Custom markdown elements for advanced features like forms and buttons are in development.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A website builder but instead of drag and drop, you can create the entire site in markdown. There are a dozen or so themes the user can select.

Currently implementing custom markdown elements for more advanced things like forms and buttons.
